title: Professional Services Consultant
jobDescription: Job Description Professional Services within Fortinet, is an integral part of the support and services organization, as a result the Consultant will collaborate effectively with peers to drive customer satisfaction. The Consultant delivers Professional Services as part of their regional team, on site and remotely to customers. The Consultant delivers technical services including design, implementation, migration, optimization and related documentation. The Consultant also participates in scoping projects in the pre-Sales phase and is aware of best practice methodology to build and construct a Scope of Work. The Consultant instils confidence to customers through their technical ability, focused communication skills and structured approach to implementing security solutions. This role requires a constant focus on improving technical skills through training or on-job learning opportunities. The Consultant needs to be collaborative and build effective working relationships within Fortinet to drive success. The Consultant is expected to contribute to team processes and highlight to management any risk to projects. Responsibilities The Professional Services Consultant: Delivers assigned projects to the satisfaction of the Customer in collaboration with the PMO team including deployment, configuration, knowledge transfer, testing and troubleshooting of products and technologies in the customer environment. Assists on site throughout a rollout, migration or go-live phase with a focus on minimizing risk and maximizing customer satisfaction Performs project risk analysis, reports escalated issues and implements mitigation plans. Develops an understanding of customer engagements (objectives, project scope, business and technical requirements) to ensure expectations are met. Produces project related documents including any required technical architecture diagrams. These documents might include High-Level Design, Low-Level Design, Migration Plan, Test Plan, Methods of Procedures, Network Implementation Plan, As-Built guide. Ensures that project documents are accurate, complete, current and stored appropriately. Owns and contributes to the resolution of complex technical issues in relation to projects in delivery. Collaborates with the Customer and other teams (PS, Support and Sales Engineering). Collaborate with developers to put automation concepts into practice for high-quality and efficient delivery. Drives technical scoping meetings and develops statements of work with the relevant work breakdown structures based on accurate analysis of customers' requirements. Reviews peer documents for technical accuracy and quality assurance. Manages time, and completes and submits administrative tasks in a timely manner. Continuously works on developing knowledge and skills to remain proficient with the relevant Fortinet technologies, products and services by using self-study materials or by formal trainings. Feeds back customer input with the aim of improving services and process. Contributes to collateral such as templates, methodologies, best practice or lessons learned. Mentors other consultants on Fortinet Professional Services practices and methodologies. Job Requirements 9+ years’ experience in LAN/WAN/Internet consulting, support and/or administration. 8+ years’ experience with network security products. Experience working as an IT security consultant or architect. Extensive experience in designing, deploying, and managing NGFW solutions is required. Hands on experience working on any of the top NGFW vendors like Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto and Checkpoint Extensive experience designing and deploying Web Proxy and Secure Web Gateways solution Hands-on experience working with SASE solutions like Zscaler, Netskope, Prisma Access is an added advantage Expertise in at least 3 of the following technologies:, Advanced Threat Protection, Endpoint Security, Application Security, Web Application Firewall, Network Security Management, SIEM, SD-WAN and/or other cloud-based technologies. Knowledge of python or any scripting language is highly desirable Knowledge of virtualization software like VMware, Hyper-V, KVM is an added plus Knowledge of API programmability/automation is desired but not mandatory Excellent presentation, communication and technical documentation skills. Excellent troubleshooting skills with a systematic approach to problem solving. Proven ability to work independently as well as in a team in a collaborative environment. Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including management, clients, and other departments. Ability to adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines. Flexible working hours. Positive customer service attitude with excellent soft skills. Ability to bring projects to successful completion. Strong commitment, self-driven with good team leadership skills. Travel (up to 30%). Education Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering in Computer Science or Information Technology and equivalent extensive work-related experience.

title: Professional Services Consultant - P3
jobDescription: Job Description Professional Services within Fortinet, is an integral part of the support and services organization, as a result the Consultant will collaborate effectively with peers to drive customer satisfaction. The Consultant delivers Professional Services as part of their regional team, on site and remotely to customers. The Consultant delivers technical services including design, implementation, migration, optimization and related documentation. The Consultant also participates in scoping projects in the pre-Sales phase and is aware of best practice methodology to build and construct a Scope of Work. The Consultant instils confidence to customers through their technical ability, focused communication skills and structured approach to implementing security solutions. This role requires a constant focus on improving technical skills through training or on-job learning opportunities. The Consultant needs to be collaborative and build effective working relationships within Fortinet to drive success. The Consultant is expected to contribute to team processes and highlight to management any risk to projects. Responsibilities The Professional Services Consultant: Delivers assigned projects to the satisfaction of the Customer in collaboration with the PMO team including deployment, configuration, knowledge transfer, testing and troubleshooting of products and technologies in the customer environment. Assists on site throughout a rollout, migration or go-live phase with a focus on minimizing risk and maximizing customer satisfaction Performs project risk analysis, reports escalated issues and implements mitigation plans. Develops an understanding of customer engagements (objectives, project scope, business and technical requirements) to ensure expectations are met. Produces project related documents including any required technical architecture diagrams. These documents might include High-Level Design, Low-Level Design, Migration Plan, Test Plan, Methods of Procedures, Network Implementation Plan, As-Built guide. Ensures that project documents are accurate, complete, current and stored appropriately. Owns and contributes to the resolution of complex technical issues in relation to projects in delivery. Collaborates with the Customer and other teams (PS, Support and Sales Engineering). Collaborate with developers to put automation concepts into practice for high-quality and efficient delivery. Drives technical scoping meetings and develops statements of work with the relevant work breakdown structures based on accurate analysis of customers' requirements. Reviews peer documents for technical accuracy and quality assurance. Manages time, and completes and submits administrative tasks in a timely manner. Continuously works on developing knowledge and skills to remain proficient with the relevant Fortinet technologies, products and services by using self-study materials or by formal trainings. Feeds back customer input with the aim of improving services and process. Contributes to collateral such as templates, methodologies, best practice or lessons learned. Mentors other consultants on Fortinet Professional Services practices and methodologies. Job Requirements 9+ years’ experience in LAN/WAN/Internet consulting, support and/or administration. 8+ years’ experience with network security products. Experience working as an IT security consultant or architect. Extensive experience in designing, deploying, and managing NGFW solutions is required. Hands on experience working on any of the top NGFW vendors like Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto and Checkpoint Extensive experience designing and deploying Web Proxy and Secure Web Gateways solution Hands-on experience working with SASE solutions like Zscaler, Netskope, Prisma Access is an added advantage Expertise in at least 3 of the following technologies:, Advanced Threat Protection, Endpoint Security, Application Security, Web Application Firewall, Network Security Management, SIEM, SD-WAN and/or other cloud-based technologies. Knowledge of python or any scripting language is highly desirable Knowledge of virtualization software like VMware, Hyper-V, KVM is an added plus Knowledge of API programmability/automation is desired but not mandatory Excellent presentation, communication and technical documentation skills. Excellent troubleshooting skills with a systematic approach to problem solving. Proven ability to work independently as well as in a team in a collaborative environment. Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including management, clients, and other departments. Ability to adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines. Flexible working hours. Positive customer service attitude with excellent soft skills. Ability to bring projects to successful completion. Strong commitment, self-driven with good team leadership skills. Travel (up to 30%). Education Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering in Computer Science or Information Technology and equivalent extensive work-related experience.

title: Professional Services Tech Lead/Architect
jobDescription: Job Description Professional Services within Fortinet, is an integral part of the support and services organization, as a result the Consultant will collaborate effectively with peers to drive customer satisfaction. The Consultant delivers Professional Services as part of their regional team, on site and remotely to customers. The Consultant delivers technical services including design, implementation, migration, optimization and related documentation. The Consultant also participates in scoping projects in the pre-Sales phase and is aware of best practice methodology to build and construct a Scope of Work. The Consultant instils confidence to customers through their technical ability, focused communication skills and structured approach to implementing security solutions. This role requires a constant focus on improving technical skills through training or on-job learning opportunities. The Consultant needs to be collaborative and build effective working relationships within Fortinet to drive success. The Consultant is expected to contribute to team processes and highlight to management any risk to projects. Job Responsibilities The Professional Services Tech Lead/Architect: Acts as the senior technical authority driving complex, large-scale migration/implementation projects— coordinating multiple resources, aligning architecture and delivery teams, managing technical and delivery risks, and ensuring successful execution across planning, design, implementation, validation, and cutover phases. Provides thought leadership in developing migration methodologies, frameworks, and best practices—especially for incubation-stage or emerging technology areas—to scale delivery excellence across the organization Lead technology transition discussions, influencing design decisions and migration approaches while driving high-quality service delivery outcomes. Translate complex customer business requirements into end-to-end solution architectures focused on technology/solution transition Lead Professional Services pre-sales , including solution scoping, effort estimation, and creation/review of Statements of Work (SOWs). Contributes to Professional Services growth by clearly articulating the capabilities and business value of migration services to diverse audiences—including Sales, and customer stakeholders Owns and resolves complex technical challenges related to product interoperability and feature parity, configuration translation, optimization, and multi-vendor integrations. Provides technical leadership during escalations by offering deep architectural guidance, collaborating closely with Engineering and Support teams, and driving timely resolution of complex issues that may impact project delivery or customer outcomes. Works with internal development teams on automation initiatives—conceptualizing use cases and collaborating with developers to implement scripting and tooling for migration efficiencies. Provide actionable insights to product management teams on feature gaps, roadmap enhancements, and real-world migration challenges. Continuously enhances technical knowledge across Fortinet Security Fabric and adjacent technologies through structured self-learning and training. Develops the reusable assets including templates, scripts, best practices, and methodologies to strengthen the migration practice. Provides mentorship and guidance to senior consultants on Fortinet Professional Services frameworks and technical execution Job Requirements 15+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity architecture, network/security design, and complex solution migrations. Experience working as a cybersecurity technical leader or an architect. Strong hands-on experience with Fortinet Security Fabric , including firewalls, SSE, application security, cloud and web security Expertise in at least 3 of the following technologies: SASE, Network Security, Application Security, Web Application Firewalls, Load Balancers and/or other cloud based technologies Knowledge of python or any scripting language is highly desirable Prior experience leading large-scale migration programs Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders and deliver high-quality technical documentation. Experience in Professional Services—presales, SOW creation, delivery governance, and customer advisory. Ability to adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines Flexible working hours. Ability to guide and mentor engineers and drive best practices across the regional delivery organization. Strong commitment, self-driven with excellent team leadership skills. Travel (up to 30%).

title: Cyber Threat Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Candidate must be self-learner and should be able to work independently with minimal assistance and available online resources and should be flexible to learn new technologies and languages. This position requires working from the office full-time; remote work is not available. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Software development using microservices with the Python programming language and web frameworks like fast API, flask etc. Participation in the design of features, evaluating impact of features on different system modules. Being open to taking up technically challenging tasks without being sandboxed into any one technical domain. Strong ability and willingness to explore, learn and deliver We Are Looking for: Exposure to the Python web frameworks like fast API, flask. 5 to 7 years relevant experience in Python Shell scripting programming experience on Linux Experience in using a wide variety of data structures/algorithms with the ability to choose the right one for the problem at hand Hands-on implementation experience with multithreaded systems Strong debugging skills on Linux Proven skills in designing software modules to meet feature requirements. Proficient in microservices architecture, Docker, Docker compose etc. Hands on experience with relational databases and non-relational databases. Proficient hands-on of No SQL – Mongo DB, Open Search Strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms. Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git. Should be a good team player who can collaborate with the team. Exposure to cloud technologies and experience in handling applications on AWS Strong Computer and networking fundamentals In-depth knowledge of various security technologies. Great to have Linux development environment and OS level debugging experience Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles. Exposure to Angular framework Knowledge of cyber threats, malware, APTs, exploits etc Experience in vulnerability assessment & penetration testing is plus. Certification of CEH, OSCP, and other cybersecurity is plus but not necessary Desired Soft Skills: Must be interested to learn new technologies and skills. Candidates must be self-starters, quick learners, detail-oriented and should feel comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-energy, deadline-driven environment Ability to prepare and present research findings both written and orally. Good analytical skills Desired Experience: 5-7 years

title: Solution Architect (Presales) - AI Security
jobDescription:
Responsibilities
- AI data Center security design: Architect zero-trust segmentation, east-west traffic inspection, and perimeter defence for AI/GPU cluster environments using Fortinet Solutio... Job Description Solution Architect (Presales) – AI Security About Fortinet Fortinet is a global leader in cybersecurity, delivering broad, integrated, and automated security solutions across networks, applications, cloud, and endpoints. As organizations rapidly adopt AI-driven technologies, Fortinet continues to innovate and help customers secure modern AI-powered environments. Role Overview Fortinet is looking for a highly skilled Solution Architect (Presales) – AI Security to support enterprise customers in designing and securing AI-driven environments. This role will work closely with Sales, Engineering, and Customers to position Fortinet’s AI Security portfolio and help organizations address emerging threats related to AI/ML workloads, Gen AI adoption, cloud security, and application protection. Key Responsibilities AI data Center security design: Architect zero-trust segmentation, east-west traffic inspection, and perimeter defence for AI/GPU cluster environments using Fortinet Solutions LLM & AI workload protection: Implement security controls for LLM inference pipelines, model serving APIs, and AI orchestration layers — including prompt injection defense and model output filtering. GPU server hardening Threat detection & SOC integration: Deploy Fortinet solutions to ingest telemetry from AI infrastructure, build AI-specific detection rules, and automate incident response playbooks. 5Network fabric & SD-WAN: Design secure inter-DC connectivity for distributed AI training clusters Pre-sales & advisory: Lead proof-of-concept engagements, deliver technical presentations, and serve as a trusted advisor to Enterprise, Commercial, and Strategic customers build and secure AI infrastructure. Support RFP/RFI responses and technical solution design Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams on customer requirements and AI security use cases Stay updated on trends related to Gen AI, LLM Security, Adversarial AI, and AI governance Required Skills & Experience 8–15 years of experience in Presales / Solution Architecture within Cybersecurity Strong understanding of Network Security, Cloud Security, SASE, ZTNA, and Application Security. Experience working with AWS, Azure, and GCP environments. Understanding of AI/ML concepts, APIs, and AI application environments. Experience managing enterprise and strategic customer engagements. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AI Security, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, or Dev Sec Ops technologies. Understanding of LLM risks and secure AI adoption. Relevant certifications such as NSE, AWS/Azure, CISSP, or CCSP. Experience with cybersecurity vendors or cloud security companies preferred. Why Join Fortinet? Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and cybersecurity technologies while engaging with leading enterprise customers and strategic digital transformation initiatives.
